purpose: Every recovery archive this repository holds, with the digest that identifies it, the producer that wrote it and the retention that expires it. An archive that is not listed here has no provenance, no digest and no expiry.
retention: A recovery archive is retained until the owner authorizes its deletion. No archive in this ledger is ever the canonical record of anything, and none of them is a restore source on its own.
